newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Friend of Rabin assassin to be charged in case.
newsitem.headline: Friend of Rabin assassin to be charged in case.

text.p: A female friend of the killer of Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin is going to be charged in connection with the assassination, the Ministry of Justice said on Monday.

The ministry said Margalit Har-Shefi, a friend of convicted assassin Yigal Amir, was going to be charged in a Tel Aviv court on Tuesday for failing to prevent a crime and giving the means to commit a crime.

Rabin was shot dead on November 4, 1995, by Amir, a religious Jew opposed to Rabin's policy of handing Arabs occupied land for peace. Har-Shefi, who lives in a West Bank settlement, was a friend of Amir's at Bar-Ilan University.

Amir was sentenced to jail for life. His brother and another friend were convicted as conspirators and sentenced for five to 12 years in prison. The Justice Ministry said it had closed the files of five other people investigated in the case.
